title: Unit 1: The Mysterious Passing of January 19, 1990: Anatomy of an Unexplained Death
themes: The shocking timeline of January 19, 1990 inside the inner sanctum of Lao Tzu House
The sudden deterioration of Osho’s health without external medical consultation
The complete isolation of the master from the wider sannyasin community and family
The contrast between official commune press releases and forensic irregularities
The immediate clampdown on information and the enforcement of institutional silence

title: Unit 2: The Suspicious Demise of Nirvano (Vivek): The Tragic Fate of Osho’s Companion
themes: The central role of Christine Woolf (Ma Yoga Vivek / Nirvano) as Osho’s personal caretaker for 20 years
The mysterious circumstances of Nirvano’s death on December 9, 1989—exactly 41 days before Osho’s passing
The official narrative of suicide by drug overdose vs. allegations of foul play and forced sedation
The swift, secretive disposal of her body without proper police inquiry or intimation to family
The removal of Osho’s most loyal protector from the inner perimeter of Lao Tzu House

title: Unit 3: The Coterie in Lao Tzu House: Jayesh, Amrito, and Anando’s Grip on Power
themes: The emergence of the post-Oregon administrative triumvirate: Michael O’Byrne (Jayesh), Dr. John Andrews (Amrito), and Catherine Woolf (Anando)
The systematic sidelining of Osho’s Indian disciples, family members, and early ashram trustees
The control of access: filtering information, dictating visitor protocols, and managing the master’s physical dependency
The corporate transformation of the ashram into a centralized, opaque multinational bureaucracy
The intense power struggle over succession, intellectual property, and real estate assets

title: Unit 4: The Procured Death Certificate: Dr. Gokul Gokani and the Breach of Medical Protocol
themes: The extraordinary testimony of Dr. Gokul Gokani, a respected Pune physician and long-time sannyasin
How Dr. Gokani was summoned to Lao Tzu House hours after Osho had supposedly died
The coercion: Dr. Gokani pressured to sign a death certificate declaring "heart failure" without examining the body
The absence of attending cardiologists or diagnostic equipment in an alleged cardiac crisis
Dr. Gokani’s subsequent formal retraction and public affidavits detailing institutional fraud

title: Unit 5: The Hasty Cremation and Silenced Witnesses: Mother Saraswati’s Desperate Cry
themes: The unprecedented rush to cremate Osho’s body within one hour of the public announcement
The total absence of a mandatory post-mortem autopsy despite suspicious circumstances
The exclusion of Osho’s biological mother, Ma Amrit Saraswati, and brother Swami Shailendra from his bedside
Mother Saraswati’s agonized public exclamation at the burning ghat: "They have killed you, my son!"
The swift dispersal and intimidation of disciples who raised forensic questions

title: Unit 6: The Medical Forensic Conundrum: Heart Failure, Overdose, or Poisoning?
themes: Investigating the competing hypotheses of Osho’s cause of death: natural cardiac arrest vs. medical foul play
The long-term effects of the 1985 US thallium and radiation poisoning on his cardiovascular system
The alleged administration of high-potency sedatives, tranquilizers, and painkillers by the attending medical coterie
The complete disappearance of Osho’s official medical charts and prescription records
The forensic impossibility of definitive proof due to the deliberate destruction of the physical remains

title: Unit 7: The Siphoning of an Empire: Disbanding the Commune and Diverting Global Intellectual Property
themes: The immense valuation of the Osho estate: prime Pune real estate, luxury assets, and global copyright
The systematic transfer of publishing rights, audio-video master tapes, and trademarks out of Indian public trusts
The establishment of offshore entities in Zurich, Switzerland: Osho International Foundation (OIF)
The siphoning of royalties, merchandise sales, and meditation camp fees into private Swiss accounts
The financial disenfranchisement of the Indian public charitable trust that originally owned the assets

title: Unit 8: The Battle of the Forged Will: Zurich, New York, and the European Trademark Wars
themes: The sudden emergence in 2013 of an alleged "Last Will and Testament" of Osho dated June 16, 1989
The shocking content of the will: bequeathing all rights, properties, and trademarks exclusively to Michael O’Byrne (Jayesh)
Forensic handwriting analysis conducted in New York, Italy, and India demonstrating the signature was an amateur forgery
The legal defeat of OIF in the European Union Intellectual Property Office (EUIPO) attempting to trademark the word "OSHO"
The ongoing criminal complaints filed by veteran sannyasins under the Indian Penal Code and High Court petitions

title: Unit 9: The Commercial Resort Rebranding: Erasing Sannyas and Commodifying Spirituality
themes: The deliberate corporate rebranding of the Pune Ashram into the "Osho International Meditation Resort"
The systematic erasure of Osho’s traditional symbols: banning the mala, dropping the orange/red robes, suppressing photos
The imposition of exorbitant daily gate fees, pricing out ordinary Indian seekers in favor of wealthy Western tourists
The destruction and attempted demolition of historic ashram buildings, including plans regarding Osho’s Samadhi
The ideological clash between a sacred spiritual mystery school and a luxury corporate wellness spa

title: Unit 10: The Unanswered Indictment: Demands for a Special Investigation Team (SIT) and Truth
themes: The synthesis of Abhay Vaidya’s multi-year journalistic investigation into a comprehensive legal and moral indictment
The formal petition for a court-monitored Special Investigation Team (SIT) to reopen the death inquiry
The call for an exhaustive forensic audit of OIF Zurich and Indian trust assets by the CBI and Enforcement Directorate
The spiritual resilience of the global sannyas community resisting corporate control
The enduring immortality of Osho’s spoken vision beyond all bureaucratic machinations and mortal crimes
